data.title: 黑歌 · 隐秘温泉的黑猫出浴
data.description: 隐秘深山的温泉私汤水汽袅袅，清澈泉水在黑夜中映出月光。黑歌坐在温泉池边的石阶上，双足轻荡池水。湿漉的黑发贴在光洁白皙的背脊上，两只猫耳因温热的水汽而微微垂下，纤细的双尾在水面拍打出涟漪。她转过身来单手遮胸，眼眸迷离泛着诱人红晕，散发着野性又娇嗔的猫妖风情。
data.location: private natural rock hot spring shrouded in steam
data.action: 坐在温泉池边的石阶上，双足轻荡池水，湿漉的黑发贴在光洁白皙的背脊上

data.promptProse: Perched on smooth wet rocks at the edge of a secluded mountain hot spring at night, Kuroka dips her bare feet into the steaming pool while damp strands of hair cling to her bare back. Turning toward the viewer with one hand drawn playfully across her chest, she flashes a teasing, misty-eyed blush as cool moonlight cuts through the rising bath steam.
data.animaCaption: Perched nude on the wet stone steps of the secluded mountain hot spring with one hand drawn playfully over her chest, Kuroka glances back through the rising steam with a flushed, teasing smile. Cool silver moonlight shines over the rippling water and her damp skin.
